import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB
capacity_record = next((r for r in LEGACY_RECORDS if r['source'].endswith('capacity.csv')))
capacity = int(capacity_record['values']['Capacity'])
product_records = [r for r in LEGACY_RECORDS if r['source'].endswith('products.csv')]
product_names = [r['values']['ProductName'] for r in product_records]
profit = {r['values']['ProductName']: int(r['values']['Value']) for r in product_records}
weight = {r['values']['ProductName']: int(r['values']['Weight']) for r in product_records}
if not len(product_names) == len(profit) == len(weight):
    raise ValueError('Mismatch in product data dimensions.')
m = gp.Model('CarSales2')
x_vars = m.addVars(product_names, lb=0, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='')
m.setObjective(gp.quicksum((profit[p] * x_vars[p] for p in product_names)), GRB.MAXIMIZE)
m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((weight[p] * x_vars[p] for p in product_names)) <= capacity, name='cap')
m.Params.MIPGap = 0.0001
m.optimize()
if m.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    print(f'ObjVal: {m.ObjVal}')
    for v in m.getVars():
        print(f'{v.VarName}: {v.X}')
else:
    print(f'Solver status: {m.Status}')
